summary: Read one price for each day, listed from earlier days to later days. You may buy and sell as many times as you wish, but you can hold only one share at a time, so a new purchase waits until the previous sale has finished. Add up each sale price minus its matching buy price. Write the largest total you can obtain. Write zero when the prices never rise.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
